text:
Alex: quick follow-up on the on‑prem packaging RFC — we need a concrete proposal for version gating across disconnected 'islands'. thinking: operator-friendly, rollback-safe, and observable. thoughts?
Devon: +1, main tradeoff is gate strictness vs operator friction. strict gating avoids weird mixed-state clusters but makes recovery harder.
Maria: can we do a two‑phase activation? manifest-level pin -> staged activation -> final commit. keeps rollback path.
Alex: yeah that aligns w/ RFC but we need heuristics for automatic vs manual commit. e.g. auto-commit after N successful hosts or time window.
Sam: suggest default = manual commit for enterprise mode; auto-commit opt-in for smaller fleets. also need a clear operator command to force-roll back.
Rachel: how do we expose progress to SREs? a route in Console + event stream? need per-node state (pending/activated/failed).
Devon: agree. propose small status enum: PENDING, ACTIVATING, ACTIVATED, ACTIVATION_FAILED, ROLLBACK_PENDING, ROLLED_BACK.
Maria: +1. also add reason codes (hash-mismatch, deps-missing, timeout) so alerts are actionable.
Alex: example gating policy sketch:
```yaml
policy: 
  mode: staged
  auto_commit: false
  success_threshold: 0.6 # fraction of nodes
  min_nodes: 3
  activation_window: 48h
  rollback_on: [manifest-mismatch, activation-timeout]
```
Sam: nice. minor nit: success_threshold + min_nodes should be evaluated as absolute count when min_nodes present. so we don't get odd math.
Rachel: telemetry: emit events at each state transition and a heartbeat per-node that includes active_manifest_version and last_error. store for 90 days in Console addon.
Devon: operator UX: CLI commands: `island activate <manifest>` `island status <id>` `island force-commit <id>` `island abort <id>`. shareable links into Console timeline.
Maria: airgap nuance — some islands never see the signer/eviction svc. need offline attestations: manifest bundle includes signed attestations from vendor + local operator signature when applied.
Alex: good point. attestation flow: vendor signs bundle; operator adds site signature at activation; verifier asserts both signatures before ACTIVATED.
Sam: failure modes: partial activation (20% nodes activated) -> if rollback_on includes partial-activation then trigger ROLLBACK_PENDING and provide operator with diff and logs.
OpsBot: deploy-bot: noted — will emit lifecycle events to #release-war-room when activation enters ACTIVATED or ROLLBACK_PENDING. :robot_face: 
Rachel: one more: ensure model artifacts and large blobs use content-addressed dedupe so bundles are idempotent and small. observability should show payload delta per node.
Alex: OK next steps: Devon/Maria to draft the API surface and CLI verbs; Sam/Rachel to draft Console telemetry + alerts; I'll fold into a short RFC update. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Devon: I'll drop a PR with API sketches later today.
Maria: will try to prototype offline attestation metadata format this week.
Sam: will write CLI UX doc + examples.
Rachel: I'll stub the Console widgets and event schema.
Alex: perfect — ping me when PRs land and we'll sync on the canary criteria.
